entities.summary: Nadav Kander HonFRPS is an Israeli-born photographer, artist and director based in London, known for his portraiture and landscapes. Kander has produced a number of books and had his work exhibited widely. He received an Honorary Fellowship from the Royal Photographic Society in 2015, and won the Prix Pictet award.
